name: Ikoma Keizou
source: Grandfather of Ikoma Aoi and the former director of Kirishima Heavy Industries. He and Raiden are an old friend and promised to marry his granddaughter to Raiden's son.
translation: Grandfather of Ikoma Aoi and the former director of Kirishima Heavy Industries. He and Raiden are an old friend and promised to marry his granddaughter to Raiden's son.
